about.title: about
about.paragraph_1: a materialisation of a system failure. every work in the series is coated with lead glaze—a historical neurotoxin used as protection from radiation. this is not a metaphor but a physical condition: the objects are conditionally hazardous, passive-aggressive by nature.
about.paragraph_2: every object has a two-headed form. this is not the doppelgänger as a mystical double, but a schematic image of an irresolvable paradox. two heads on one body form a static model of cognitive dissonance, conflicting goals within a single system, and a logical dead end. dialogue has stopped; contradiction has petrified. the series consists of demonstration models in which inner or social conflict is presented not as a psychological state but as an engineering fact: structural, heavy, and cumulatively toxic. a visual equation in which two opposing minds share a single resource, history, and body.
